messages:
morgan: FYI found a weird billing/quota artifact on the canary. keys issued by old service-account flow lack a project claim and get routed to org pool, but the billing dashboard shows "Unattributed" for the line items.
lin: that explains the noisy alerts we saw last night. is it just missing header or claim?
devon: proxy logs show requests like:
```
POST /v1/chat/completions
Authorization: Bearer sk_xxx
X-Org: org_237
# no X-Project or project_id claim
```
sam: router uses org fallback for placement so serve is fine. downstream metering requires project to attach quota labels. when project==null, it writes to projectless which fires our per-project threshold alerts.
morgan: customer-facing problem: tenant dashboards say "you exceeded project quota" even though the org pool served the request. Support is getting tickets.
lin: telemetry: auth.missing_project.count=18 last_24h, mostly from keys created before 2023-06 onboarding change.
telemetry-bot: metric auth.missing_project.count=18 window=24h breakdown={sa_old_onboard:14, api_migration:4}
devon: Suggestion: create a synthetic project label when missing: `proj:org-<orgid>-legacy` for quota/billing attribution only. Emit an audit event so CS can reconcile. Also surface a non-blocking banner on the key's console page: "Key uses legacy org-level attribution (learn more)".
sam: +1. That preserves quotas and stops alerts. Need to ensure invoice exports and BigQuery exports include the synthetic project column name. Also add a flag so we can switch attribution mode for a single org during migration.
lin: UX: key details page -> top metadata row, small gray pill: "Attribution: org (legacy project placeholder)" with a link to docs and a button "Migrate to project-scoped key". Clicking runs the migration flow or schedules a support ticket.
morgan: migration plan: 1) one-off backfill job to map active keys to default project where we can infer, 2) for remaining keys tag with synthetic project id, 3) enable console pill + billing label change, 4) flip monitoring to stop counting projectless alerts.
devon: Implementation notes: patch metering pipeline to accept synthetic project token and treat it as a normal project for SLOs, but keep a boolean column `legacy_attribution=true`. Emit telemetry flag auth.attribution_mode=synthetic for visibility.
sam: Security check: confirm no permission change - only labeling. Also ensure exported invoices keep org-level line items as before.
lin: I'll draft console copy and docs. morgan/devo n can you outline the backfill query and the safe-guards?
morgan: will post a snippet tomorrow. for now I'll add an RFC issue and tag infra/telemetry/support. :thumbsup:
telemetry-bot: action created=rfc/legacy-key-attribution id=RFC-4425 assigned=[lin,devon,morgan]
